data_description_zh:
1. 國民營養健康狀況變遷調查(Nutrition And Health Survey in Taiwan ，NAHSIT) 營
養狀況是影響健康的重要因素，亦是國民健康重要指標之一，國民營養監測調查
則是瞭解國民營養狀況之必要作為。102-105年「國民營養健康調查」，主要目標
係以全人口為基礎之抽樣設計，規劃建立長期、穩定且即時之國民健康及飲食型
態監測系統，於102至105年間逐年蒐集建立穩定足量的全人口樣本資料，並且可
以使每個單年度能有具全國代表性資料，合併4年可產生具縣市代表性資料以供全
國營養及非傳染病政策制定參考應用。
2. 102-105年國民營養健康調查內容包括受訪者基本人口學資料、飲食攝取資料、疾
病及環境暴露資料、健康風險行為資料、家族疾病史資料、ㄧ般體位及身體檢查
、血液尿液等生化檢查。

fields.name_zh: 1.產婦若在生產後一個月內經常哺乳，能使乳汁分泌更多
fields.name_zh_en: 1. If a mother breastfeeds frequently within one month after delivery, she can produce more milk

fields.name_zh: 2.嬰兒餵食副食品，如紅蘿蔔、蘋果等，只要嬰兒吃的下，食物大小沒關係。
fields.name_zh_en: 2. When feeding complementary foods such as carrots and apples, the size of the food does not matter as long as the infant can eat it.

fields.name_zh: 3.嬰兒奶粉沖泡濃度增加，有利嬰兒生長。
fields.name_zh_en: 3. Increasing the concentration of infant formula is beneficial for infant growth.

fields.name_zh: 4.嬰兒奶粉較母乳容易消化。
fields.name_zh_en: 4. Infant formula is easier to digest than breast milk.

fields.name_zh: 5.初乳含有豐富的營養與免疫物質。
fields.name_zh_en: 5. Colostrum is rich in nutrients and immune substances.

fields.name_zh: 6.一至三個月的嬰兒除了嬰兒奶粉或母乳外，可添加果汁。
fields.name_zh_en: 6. Infants one to three months old can be given juice in addition to infant formula or breast milk.

fields.name_zh: 7.四至六個月以上的嬰兒應依順序添加副食品。
fields.name_zh_en: 7. Infants four to six months or older should be given complementary foods in sequence.

fields.name_zh: 8.添加新食物時，最好多種一起混合添加。
fields.name_zh_en: 8. When adding new foods, it is best to add several mixed together.

fields.name_zh: 9.提前餵食副食品容易造成嬰兒過敏現象。
fields.name_zh_en: 9. Feeding complementary foods early easily causes allergies in infants.

fields.name_zh: 10.哺餵母乳的嬰兒，可以晚一點添加副食品。
fields.name_zh_en: 10. Breastfed infants can have complementary foods added a little later.

fields.name_zh: 11.製作嬰兒副食品，應添加調味料（糖、鹽）。
fields.name_zh_en: 11. When preparing infant complementary foods, seasonings (sugar, salt) should be added.

fields.name_zh: 12.嬰兒添加副食品需先從肉類開始。
fields.name_zh_en: 12. When adding complementary foods, infants should start with meat.

fields.name_zh: 13.從糞便或皮膚變化狀況可以判定添加新食物對嬰兒有無不良影響。
fields.name_zh_en: 13. Changes in stool or skin can be used to judge whether adding a new food has an adverse effect on the infant.

fields.name_zh: 14.為嬰兒添加麥粉時與奶粉共同泡入奶瓶中吸食比較方便。
fields.name_zh_en: 14. When adding cereal for an infant, it is more convenient to mix it with formula in the bottle.

fields.name_zh: 15.嬰兒奶粉中最好加入營養補充品 (例如如維生素、礦物質、雞精、魚油、高蛋白粉、中藥及中藥製品等)以促進嬰兒發育與健康。
fields.name_zh_en: 15. It is best to add nutritional supplements (e.g., vitamins, minerals, essence of chicken, fish oil, high-protein powder, Chinese herbal medicine and herbal products) to infant formula to promote infant development and health.

fields.name_zh: 16.母奶哺育可預防嬰兒過敏。
fields.name_zh_en: 16. Breastfeeding can prevent infant allergies.

fields.name_zh: 17.蜂蜜水可以幫助嬰兒便秘問題。
fields.name_zh_en: 17. Honey water can help with infant constipation.

fields.name_zh: 18.為了改善嬰兒腸胃道毛病，可餵嬰兒吃益生菌。

fields.name_zh: 1.給幼兒盡量多吃，體格好比較不會生病。
fields.name_zh_en: 1. Let young children eat as much as possible; with a good physique they are less likely to get sick.

fields.name_zh: 2.給孩子吃營養補充品（例如維生素、礦物質、雞精、魚油、高蛋白粉、中藥及中藥製品等），對於生長發育、體力及智力都有幫助。
fields.name_zh_en: 2. Giving children nutritional supplements (e.g., vitamins, minerals, essence of chicken, fish oil, high-protein powder, Chinese herbal medicine and herbal products) helps growth and development, physical strength and intelligence.

fields.name_zh: 3.羊奶可以改善氣管的功能。
fields.name_zh_en: 3. Goat milk can improve airway function.

fields.name_zh: 4.只要吃飽，幼兒吃何種食物都無所謂。
fields.name_zh_en: 4. As long as young children are full, it does not matter what food they eat.

fields.name_zh: 5.食物沾醬(如蕃茄醬、甜味醬、醬油膏等)吃太多對幼兒身體不好。
fields.name_zh_en: 5. Eating too much dipping sauce (e.g., ketchup, sweet sauce, thick soy sauce) is bad for young children's health.

fields.name_zh: 6.幼兒不挑食是好的飲食習慣。
fields.name_zh_en: 6. Not being a picky eater is a good eating habit for young children.

fields.name_zh: 7.幼兒體重過重或肥胖對幼兒的身體及心理健康都不利。
fields.name_zh_en: 7. Overweight or obesity in young children is bad for their physical and mental health.

fields.name_zh: 8.過敏體質的幼兒不能喝牛奶。
fields.name_zh_en: 8. Young children with an allergic constitution cannot drink cow's milk.

fields.name_zh: 9.幼兒胃口小，一餐吃不了太多，因此每天都要吃三餐及上下午兩次點心才能得到足夠的營養。
fields.name_zh_en: 9. Young children have small appetites and cannot eat much at one meal, so they need three meals and two snacks (morning and afternoon) every day to get enough nutrition.

fields.name_zh: 10.幼兒口渴時，給他喝白開水比喝汽水等含糖飲料好。
fields.name_zh_en: 10. When young children are thirsty, giving them plain water is better than sugar-sweetened drinks such as soda.

fields.name_zh: 11.常吃油炸的食物對幼兒身體有害。
fields.name_zh_en: 11. Frequently eating fried foods is harmful to young children.

fields.name_zh: 12.幼兒可以常吃蛋糕、餅乾、布丁等甜食，對身體沒有害處。
fields.name_zh_en: 12. Young children can often eat sweets such as cake, cookies, and pudding without harm to their bodies.

fields.name_zh: 13.培養幼兒吃全穀類(如糙米飯、全麥麵包)的食物有益健康。
fields.name_zh_en: 13. Getting young children used to eating whole grain foods (e.g., brown rice, whole-wheat bread) is good for health.

fields.name_zh: 14.幼兒每天吃蔬菜水果，可預防便秘。
fields.name_zh_en: 14. Young children eating vegetables and fruit every day can prevent constipation.

fields.name_zh: 15.蛋黃是供應幼兒鐵質的良好食物來源。
fields.name_zh_en: 15. Egg yolk is a good food source of iron for young children.

fields.name_zh: 16.給幼兒每天吃各種不同的天然食物是獲得營養最好的方法。
fields.name_zh_en: 16. Giving young children a variety of natural foods every day is the best way to get nutrition.

fields.name_zh: 17.牛奶是健康骨骼與牙齒成長的重要食物。
fields.name_zh_en: 17. Cow's milk is an important food for healthy bone and tooth growth.

fields.name_zh: 18.幼兒如果不吃東西，可以用牛奶或幼兒成長奶粉來代替。

fields.description_zh:
1:睡覺：或躺在床上休息
2:坐著：吃東西、聽、寫、讀、看電視或看電影
3:站著：洗東西、括鬍子、梳頭髮、煮東西等類似活動
4:慢走(少於 4公里/小時)：開車、穿衣服、淋浴等
5:日常輕度工作：如掃地、擦洗窗戶、油漆、餐廳服務生工作、護理日常工作、電器修護工作、酒保工作、走路在 4-6公里/小時等類似活動
6:休閒運動：打棒球/壘球、高爾夫球、排球、保齡球、桌球、射箭、划船、騎腳踏車(少於10公里/小時)等類似活動
7:日常中度工作：挖礦、木工、蓋房子、除雪、裝載和卸貨、砍木材、修繕房舍等類似活動
8:高強度休閒運動(非競賽性
質)：騎自由車 15公里/小時以上、舞蹈、滑雪、羽毛球、體操、跆拳道、柔道、游泳、網球、籃球、騎馬、馬術、健身術、走路在6公里/小時以上等類似活動
9:高強度日常工作或運動競賽：伐木、搬運重物、跑步在 9公里/小時以上、越野滑雪、手球、跆拳道、柔道、羽毛球、網球、游泳、健行、登山、橄欖球、籃球、足球、背負重物、有氧舞蹈等類似活動僅用於 2013年

1. 國民營養健康狀況變遷調查(Nutrition And Health Survey in Taiwan ，NAHSIT) 營
養狀況是影響健康的重要因素，亦是國民健康重要指標之一，國民營養監測調查
則是瞭解國民營養狀況之必要作為。102-105年「國民營養健康調查」，主要目標
係以全人口為基礎之抽樣設計，規劃建立長期、穩定且即時之國民健康及飲食型
態監測系統，於102至105年間逐年蒐集建立穩定足量的全人口樣本資料，並且可
以使每個單年度能有具全國代表性資料，合併4年可產生具縣市代表性資料以供全
國營養及非傳染病政策制定參考應用。
2. 102-105年國民營養健康調查內容包括受訪者基本人口學資料、飲食攝取資料、疾
病及環境暴露資料、健康風險行為資料、家族疾病史資料、ㄧ般體位及身體檢查
、血液尿液等生化檢查。

data_description_en:
1. The Nutrition and Health Survey in Taiwan (NAHSIT): nutritional status is an important factor affecting health and one of the key indicators of national health, and nutrition monitoring surveys are a necessary undertaking for understanding the nutritional status of the population. The primary goal of the 2013-2016 (ROC years 102-105) "National Nutrition and Health Survey" was to use a population-based sampling design to plan and establish a long-term, stable, and timely monitoring system for national health and dietary patterns. Data were collected annually from 2013 to 2016 to build a stable and adequately sized whole-population sample, so that each single year could yield nationally representative data, and combining the four years could produce county/city-representative data for reference in formulating national nutrition and non-communicable disease policy.
2. The content of the 2013-2016 National Nutrition and Health Survey included respondents' basic demographic data, dietary intake data, disease and environmental exposure data, health risk behavior data, family disease history data, general anthropometric and physical examination data, and blood and urine biochemical tests, among others.
